# Metric reference

Every metric family the VMAFx services serve on their Prometheus `/metrics` page,
generated from the one definition the services build their collectors from
(`pkg/observability/metricdef`). Where each component serves the page and how to
scrape it is in the [observability guide](../development/observability.md).

Each component also serves the Go runtime and process collectors of the
Prometheus client library (`go_*`, `process_*`).

## Families

| Family | Type | Unit | Labels | Served by | Max series | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vmafx_build_info` | gauge | info | `version` | vmafx-server, vmafx-controller, vmafx-node | 2 | Constant 1, labelled with the build version. |
| `vmafx_server_score_requests_total` | counter | requests | none | vmafx-server, vmafx-controller | 1 | Total number of Score requests (HTTP + gRPC). |
| `vmafx_server_score_errors_total` | counter | requests | none | vmafx-server, vmafx-controller | 1 | Total number of Score requests that returned an error. |
| `vmafx_server_score_duration_seconds` | histogram | seconds | none | vmafx-server, vmafx-controller | 17 | End-to-end duration of a Score request in seconds. |
| `vmafx_server_health_requests_total` | counter | requests | none | vmafx-server, vmafx-controller | 1 | Total number of Health / healthz requests. |
| `vmafx_server_ready_requests_total` | counter | requests | none | vmafx-server, vmafx-controller | 1 | Total number of readyz requests. |
| `vmafx_controller_jobs_submitted_total` | counter | jobs | `tenant` | vmafx-controller | 33 | Total number of jobs submitted to the controller queue. |
| `vmafx_controller_jobs_completed_total` | counter | jobs | `tenant` | vmafx-controller | 33 | Total number of jobs that completed successfully. |
| `vmafx_controller_jobs_failed_total` | counter | jobs | `tenant` | vmafx-controller | 33 | Total number of jobs that finished with an error. |
| `vmafx_controller_jobs_cancelled_total` | counter | jobs | `tenant` | vmafx-controller | 33 | Total number of jobs cancelled before they finished. |
| `vmafx_controller_jobs_requeued_total` | counter | jobs | `reason` | vmafx-controller | 4 | Total number of running jobs returned to the queue since the controller started, by reason. |
| `vmafx_controller_jobs_pending` | gauge | jobs | `tenant` | vmafx-controller | 33 | Current number of PENDING jobs in the queue. |
| `vmafx_controller_jobs_running` | gauge | jobs | `tenant` | vmafx-controller | 33 | Current number of RUNNING jobs in the queue. |
| `vmafx_controller_queue_oldest_job_age_seconds` | gauge | seconds | `tenant` | vmafx-controller | 33 | Age of the oldest PENDING job in the queue; absent while the tenant has none. |
| `vmafx_controller_nodes_live` | gauge | nodes | none | vmafx-controller | 1 | Current number of registered (live) vmafx-node instances. |
| `vmafx_controller_job_queue_wait_seconds` | histogram | seconds | `tenant` | vmafx-controller | 495 | Time a job waited in the queue, from submission to its assignment to a node. |
| `vmafx_controller_job_duration_seconds` | histogram | seconds | `tenant`, `outcome` | vmafx-controller | 1980 | Time from a job's submission to its terminal state. |
| `vmafx_quality_score` | histogram | score | `tenant`, `model` | vmafx-server, vmafx-controller | 10659 | Distribution of the pooled VMAF scores of completed jobs and Score requests. |
| `vmafx_node_info` | gauge | info | `backend`, `vendor` | vmafx-node | 42 | Constant 1, labelled with the backend the node runs (VMAFX_BACKEND) and its GPU vendor. |
| `vmafx_node_slots` | gauge | slots | none | vmafx-node | 1 | Number of controller jobs the node runs at once (VMAFX_NODE_SLOTS); 0 without a controller. |
| `vmafx_node_jobs_running` | gauge | jobs | none | vmafx-node | 1 | Number of controller jobs the node is running now. |
| `vmafx_node_jobs_total` | counter | jobs | `backend`, `outcome` | vmafx-node | 28 | Total number of controller jobs the node finished, by backend and outcome. |
| `vmafx_node_job_duration_seconds` | histogram | seconds | `backend` | vmafx-node | 105 | Time the node spent running one controller job. |

Max series is the most series one process can serve for the family: the
product of its label bounds, times the bucket series plus `_sum` and `_count` for a
histogram. Read at scrape time: `vmafx_controller_jobs_requeued_total`, `vmafx_controller_jobs_pending`, `vmafx_controller_jobs_running`, `vmafx_controller_queue_oldest_job_age_seconds`, `vmafx_controller_nodes_live`.

## Labels

A label with a closed value set takes one of its values or `other`. An open label
reports at most its limit of distinct values per process; every later value is
merged under `other` (counts add up, ages take the oldest), so a series is
never dropped. An empty value is reported as `none`.

| Label | Values | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | open, at most 1 | build version the binary reports with `--version` |
| `tenant` | open, at most 32 | tenant of the job or request (the JWT `tid` claim); `none` on vmafx-server, which has no tenants |
| `reason` | `node_lost`, `controller_restart`, `assign_rollback` | `node_lost`: the node missed its heartbeats and was evicted; `controller_restart`: the controller restarted with the job running; `assign_rollback`: an assignment failed after the job left the queue |
| `outcome` | `completed`, `failed`, `cancelled` | terminal state of the job |
| `model` | open, at most 16 | VMAF model name the score came from; the default model when the request named none |
| `backend` | `cpu`, `cuda`, `sycl`, `hip`, `metal`, `none` | compute backend; `none` when the job named no backend and the node has none configured |
| `vendor` | `nvidia`, `amd`, `intel`, `apple`, `cpu` | GPU vendor of the node's backend (`cuda` nvidia, `hip` amd, `sycl` intel, `metal` apple) |
